title: 131K context fully loaded on AMD RX 7700 (16 GB) llama.cpp GGUF: ~300 t/s prompt, 20 t/s gen, spare memory remaining
summary: AMD RX 7700 (16 GB). Unsloth Q4_K_M.gguf (context reported 131072). Runtime: llama.cpp (GGUF). Métricas: prompt speed ~300 t/s; gen speed 20 t/s at fully loaded 131K context; spare VRAM remaining. Uso: long-context local inference on mid-range AMD GPU. Límite: First results; exact model and full config not detailed beyond Q4_K_M and 131K context. Por qué importa: Demonstrates practical long-context (131K) feasibility on consumer AMD GPU with headroom left. Useful signal for RAG or agent workloads needing large context windows without running out of VRAM.
